correctness.rationale: The factorial ratio is computed for all profitable-move cases: destination occupied with source type multiplicity 1 or at least 2, destination empty with source type multiplicity 1 or at least 2; a singleton source and within-part jumps cannot improve. Positive finite-state potential yields finite improvement. For two types the no-improvement fraction bounds across a vacant destination sum to an impossible inequality for any mixed source; disjoint vacancy placements produce the exact red polynomial. Fixed-q balanced asymptotic is dominated by one-sided vacancy terms. verify.py independently checked 125760 two-color states, 80 polynomials, 18965 multitype states and 508416 profitable moves. No inference from finite tests to all graph sizes is used.

Different payoff functions can reverse preferences as occupied-neighbor totals change, so the variety-seeking finite-improvement theorem is not dominating.

originality.rationale: The new statement concerns arbitrary positive vacancy counts on complete bipartite graphs, both balanced and unbalanced, with a factorial ordinal potential for any finite type set and a complete two-color equilibrium polynomial. The 2023 diversity-jump anchor provides regular/spider only for a single vacancy, arbitrary vacancies only at maximum degree two, and multi-vacancy cycles elsewhere. The related 2020 modified-fractional-hedonic full text uses unrestricted coalition structures and has its own general improvement cycles; it does not state or imply the fixed-capacity two-part result. The known one-vacancy specialized result is explicitly subsumed but excluded from claimed novelty. No exact covering claim was found; equivalent formulations in uninspected coalition-game literature remain a residual risk.
residual_risks: An older quota-constrained two-coalition/modified-hedonic potential theorem under distinct terminology may already yield the factorial potential; the searched and inspected sources did not resolve every possible such source.
Some relevant later variety-seeking and coalition-game papers were only checked by abstracts, not their full text.
Mathematical originality has not been independently verified.

value.rationale: The motivating 2023 fractional-diversity literature proves multi-vacancy improvement cycles on other topologies and leaves broader bipartite FIP questions open. A potential that works for every vacancy count and arbitrary finite type populations on unequal K_{A,B} is therefore a substantive infinite-family boundary. The exact two-color equilibrium-count polynomial resolves composition-specific counts (including vacancies on both sides), yields a sharp balanced asymptotic, and shows via K_{3,5} that stable fraction is not monotone in q. This is not a one-vacancy routine recomputation.
